name: PZL-104 Wilga
summary: Polish STOL utility plane widely used for glider towing and parachuting. A slim, deeply glazed fuselage gives excellent all-round visibility.

wings: High wing braced by a single strut on each side
engines: Single engine in the nose: radial on the Wilga 35, flat-six on later models
fuselage: Deeply glazed four-seat cabin on a slender, tapering rear fuselage
Tall, long-travel fixed landing gear and a nose-high stance
tail: Single fin and rudder on a slender tail cone

tellTales: Strut-braced high wing over a deeply glazed cabin with a slender tail cone
Tall, long-travel fixed gear and a nose-high stance
Glass-heavy fuselage tapering to a small tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The 180 has a conventional cabin with small rear windows; the Wilga has much more glass and a slender, tapering rear fuselage.
The Maule has a deep boxy cabin with small rear windows; the Wilga has a deeply glazed cabin and taller, longer-travel gear.
The Super Cub is a tandem two-seater with V-struts; the Wilga is a four-seater with a deep glass cabin and a single strut per side.
